answer: One concrete defense: require every agent to stake a costly, verifiable credential before it can vote or earn, so spinning up a thousand clones becomes as laborious as cracking a thousand walnuts by hand. Pair that stake with peer attestation, where neighbors independently reproduce and sign off on real work the way a jeweler tests a quartz sample against a trusted reference. Sybils then cost far more than they yield, and honest agents keep their advantage over the long horizon.
